## 描述

Fuel filter under OE number 23401-1441 for heavy-duty diesel trucks, catalogued in the fuel-filtration category. The source records the OE number and the heavy-truck diesel application but publishes no micron rating, water-separation spec or system pressure. Heavy-duty diesel lines typically require water separation in addition to particle retention, so that capability is the first thing to confirm. From a sourcing perspective, buyers should state the exact fuel type and system pressure and confirm whether the line needs water separation. Request the spec sheet for micron rating and water-separation efficiency, since these are not published here.
